name: Joseph P. Addabbo Jr.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary task force on the variable supplements fund program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary task force on the variable supplements fund program to make findings and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice to school districts and nonpublic schools located in N.Y. City of certain construction projects
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing notice to school districts and nonpublic schools located in New York city of certain construction projects; requires the New York city department of transportation to provide written notice to such school districts and nonpublic schools of certain construction projects undertaken within three hundred feet of a building of such school districts or nonpublic schools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the retrospective denial of payment for substance use disorder treatment services
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the retrospective denial of payment for substance use disorder treatment services if an insured was covered for such services at the time treatment was initiated; requires insurers to notify a treatment provider when an insured has lost coverage based on termination of the insured's employment.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the standard of care for animals held in or being transported by animal shelters; repealer
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the standard of care for animals held in or being transported by animal shelters including the length of time and conditions such animal may be exposed to.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to accept certain documentation issued to veterans of the military as acceptable proofs of identity when applying for a driver license or state identification card
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to accept a certificate of release or discharge from active duty issued by the United States department of defense (DD form 214), a veteran identification card issued by the United States department of veterans affairs, or a veterans health identification card issued by the United States department of veterans affairs from veterans of the military as acceptable proofs of identity when applying for a driver license or state identification card.

sponsored.t: Relates to host counties and host municipalities of commercial gaming facilities
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that host counties and host municipalities of commercial gaming facilities receive no reduction in appropriated aid after gaming facilities licensed under title two-A of article 13 of the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law have commenced gaming operations.
sponsored.fis: This bill would not increase the taxes, interest, or penalties imposed on any gaming facility licensee. Any fiscal impact would result from the redirection, before otherwise applicable distributions, of Title Two-A gaming facility tax revenues in an amount annually determined by the New York State Gaming Commission to be necessary to satisfy the hold harm- less. In the event a hold harmless is triggered under the legislation, it will have a positive fiscal impact for local governments.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for bruxism diagnosis and treatment
sponsored.sum: Requires policies which provide dental coverage to provide coverage for bruxism diagnosis and treatment, including the cost of occlusal guards; requires medicaid and HMO coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for endodontic services
sponsored.sum: Mandates insurance policies which cover restorative dental services to provide coverage for endodontic services including exams, imaging, root canals and post-treatment care.
sponsored.fis: The bill is expected to have minimal direct fiscal impact on the State. Administrative costs to the Department of Financial Services are expected to be absorbable within existing resources. The legislation may result in modest premium impacts associated with expanded utilization and network adequacy compliance but may also reduce long-term healthcare costs through earlier intervention and preservation of natural denti- tion.

sponsored.t: Establishes an alternative resolution program for service members and veterans accused of certain felonies
sponsored.sum: Establishes an alternative resolution program for service members and veterans accused of certain felonies.
sponsored.fis: Localities should experience a reduction in local jail costs with conse- quent fiscal savings and the State should save on reduced prison-costs. It is anticipated that the cost to the state for treatment will be negligible as many if not most, eligible veterans will receive treatment through the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.

sponsored.t: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry
sponsored.sum: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry such that it is easier to navigate; relates to the updating and availability of the registry.

sponsored.t: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health
sponsored.sum: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health.

sponsored.t: Removes restrictions on the frequency certain authorized organizations may conduct bingo games
sponsored.sum: Removes restrictions on the frequency certain authorized organizations may conduct bingo games.
sponsored.fis: There is no fiscal impact on the State or local governments.

sponsored.t: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to share monthly invoice statements to authorized consumers
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to share monthly invoice statements to authorized consumers; specifies information required.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of assumed and corporate names pertaining to household goods moving
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of assumed and corporate names by companies in the business of household goods moving; provides that companies may not use the words "mover", "moving", or "relocation service" or any abbreviation or derivative thereof unless approved by the commissioner of transportation.
sponsored.fis: This bill should not result in any significant costs to the State Department of Transportation. There may be minimal additional costs to the Department of State in implementing the provisions of this bill.

sponsored.t: Creates a temporary commission to conduct a comprehensive study on the current utilization of paid family leave, make recommendations on how to increase access and the visibility of the program
sponsored.sum: Creates a temporary commission to conduct a comprehensive study on the current utilization of paid family leave, make recommendations on how to increase access and the visibility of the program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of information on home care services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Department of Veterans' Services to consult and collaborate with relevant offices in the federal department of veterans affairs, the department of health, the state office for the aging and other HCBS experts to develop educational materials for veterans and their families about the accessibility to home and community-based services.

sponsored.t: Relates to prediction markets
sponsored.sum: Enacts the oversight and regulation of activity for contracts linked to events (ORACLE) act to provide for requirements and restrictions on prediction markets.

sponsored.t: Establishes the veterans service organizations fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the congressional chartered veterans service organizations fund; provides for gifts made to such fund on an individual's personal income tax return.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "military experience recognized for institutional transfer (MERIT) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "military experience recognized for institutional transfer (MERIT) act"; grants academic credit for veterans with regard to SUNY and CUNY college credits for military learning, training, coursework and occupational experience.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of Native American affairs
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of Native American affairs to act as a centralized office for Native American nations to access information on state programs that are provided to Native Americans.

sponsored.t: Directs the veterans service commission to submit a report regarding coordinated services for veterans with service-connected disabilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the veterans service commission to submit a report regarding coordinated services for veterans with service-connected disabilities to the commissioner of veterans' services by April 1, 2029.

sponsored.t: Relates to registered radiologic technologists working within a collaborative practice agreement with a licensed physician
sponsored.sum: Authorizes radiologic technologists to perform radiography services under collaborative practice agreements; defines "collaborative practice agreement" as an agreement between a radiologic technologist and a licensed physician which does not require the direct supervision of the licensed physician when administering certain radiography services; sets forth requirements for collaborative practice agreements.

sponsored.t: Requires digital parking payment applications to provide notice of applicable parking restrictions
sponsored.sum: Requires digital parking payment applications to provide notice of applicable parking restrictions to users based on location.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the transfer of memberships for certain members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the transfer of memberships for certain members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system who previously held a membership with the New York state and local employees' retirement system back to such retirement system.

sponsored.t: Establishes a certified community behavioral health clinic public awareness campaign
sponsored.sum: Establishes a certified community behavioral health clinic public awareness campaign to educate the public regarding certified community behavioral health clinics.

sponsored.t: Relates to wagers on certain horse racing events and authorizes agreements between a mobile sports wagering operator, mobile sports wagering licensee, or operator and certain entities
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to wagers on certain horse racing events; authorizes agreements between a mobile sports wagering operator, mobile sports wagering licensee, or operator and an entity that possesses a license and that has the authority to conduct pari-mutuel wagering on the form of racing involved in the relevant horse racing event, involving wagers to be made solely by residents of the state of New York while located within New York, and subject to the approval of the commission.

sponsored.t: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
sponsored.sum: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase.

sponsored.t: Includes offenses involving physical harm or danger to others to be qualifying offenses for the purpose of allowing a principal to be eligible to be held on bail
sponsored.sum: Includes offenses involving situations where a person physically harms another or engages in conduct that results in an unacceptable level of danger as qualifying offenses for the purpose of allowing a principal to be eligible to be held on bail; requires the Office of Court Administration, in conjunction with the New York State Division of Criminal Justice Services, to manage an electronic tracking system maintaining a record of all bail decisions and to deliver a report to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Brendon's law" relating to motor vehicle speed contests, races, sideshows and street takeovers
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Brendon's law" to prohibit participation, including spectators within two hundred feet, of any motor vehicle speed contest, sideshow and street takeovers; authorizes seizure and forfeiture; adds damaging an authorized emergency vehicle as constituting the crime of criminal mischief in the third degree.

sponsored.t: Enhances know your customer requirements and responsible gaming procedures
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Enhances know your customer requirements and responsible gaming procedures; relates to the opening and closing of an authorized sports bettor's account; prohibits an authorized sports bettor from allowing another person to access such bettor's account; allows a bettor who does so to be designated a prohibited bettor; provides for the disposition of revenues from violation fines.

sponsored.t: Requires every sale of a bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter to include a helmet suitable for use while operating such bicycle or scooter
sponsored.sum: Requires every sale of a bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter to include a helmet suitable for use while operating such bicycle or scooter.

sponsored.t: Requires certain information to be provided at the point of sale of bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires certain information to be provided in the form of a card or pamphlet at the point of sale of every bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

sponsored.t: Requires e-bikes and electric scooters to be registered and have license plates
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters to be registered with the department of motor vehicles and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of criminal justice to create and disseminate to police departments a video on bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice to create and disseminate to police departments a video on bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters including information on classification and definitions, legal operation, speed limits and enforcement, helmet and age requirements, and a review of legal operation of such devices.

sponsored.t: Establishes a public animal cruelty registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a public animal cruelty registry that requires persons over eighteen years of age convicted of animal abuse to register with the division of criminal justice services; requires such registry to contain certain information about each person registered; requires persons registered to pay an annual surcharge of fifty dollars to be used for costs and expenses associated with maintaining the registry.

sponsored.t: Protects the health insurance benefits of retirees of public employers and contributions of Medicare-eligible retirees of public employers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public employers from diminishing health insurance benefits provided to Medicare-eligible retirees and their Medicare-eligible dependents or the contributions such employer makes for such health insurance coverage below the level of such benefits or contributions made on behalf of such retirees and dependents by the public employer as of December 31, 2021.

sponsored.t: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation
sponsored.sum: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for dental night guards
sponsored.sum: Provides that dental insurance coverage shall include coverage for night guards; defines dental night guards; provides that dental night guards shall be covered under Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Creates the crime of related use of a lethal or explosive device
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of related use of a lethal or explosive device; provides for additional 10 years imprisonment for certain crimes where a lethal or explosive device is used; permits exemption from such additional sentence when the defendant provides court with the source of such lethal or explosive device.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of campaign funds for any settlement fees, fines or penalties for sexual harassment civil or criminal actions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of campaign funds to pay any settlement fees, fines or penalties for sexual harassment civil or criminal actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to cemetery desecration; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the $250 amount of damage from cemetery desecration in the second degree; makes cemetery desecration in the second degree a class E felony to apply to any damage or theft regardless of value; adds crime of cemetery desecration in the first degree and makes such crime a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to giving and/or receiving unlawful benefits
sponsored.sum: Makes it a felony to give or receive unlawful benefits in excess of $3000.

sponsored.t: Relates to unsold instant lottery game tickets
sponsored.sum: Requires the return of unsold instant lottery game tickets to the division of the lottery when a licensed agent goes out of business, sells their business or if their license is suspended or revoked.

sponsored.t: Relates to school session days
sponsored.sum: Relates to school session days; adds general election day to the list of days when school will not be in session; allows a school district to elect to require staff attendance on a general election day or to schedule a professional development day.

sponsored.t: Provides for limited credit time allowances
sponsored.sum: Provides for limited credit time allowances for working in the horse handling program for a period of no less than eighteen months and receipt of a certification from the Groom Elite program.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility requirements for horses participating in the three racing levels of the New York Sire Stakes program
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility requirements for horses participating in the three racing levels of the New York Sire Stakes program.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain veterans service organizations from taxes on the sales of beer, wine and soda
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain veterans service organizations from taxes on the sales of beer, wine and soda.

sponsored.t: Establishes a mandatory statewide, classroom-based water safety education program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mandatory statewide, classroom-based water safety education program; provides that the commissioner of education shall work with New York State Association for Health, Physical Education, Recreation and Dance certified educators to develop and promulgate a statewide, age-appropriate, classroom-based water safety education guidance document; provides that within twenty-four months of the effective date of the bill, the department of education shall initiate statewide implementation of water safety education; provides that instruction shall be classroom-based and waterless and shall not require student access to aquatic facilities, swimming instruction, or in-water assessment.

sponsored.t: Requires the state to keep state lottery winners identities anonymous
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to keep state lottery winners' identities anonymous to the general public unless the lottery winner gives their consent.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of airway clearance devices in schools
sponsored.sum: Provides for the use of airway clearance devices in schools; provides for training for school employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation in games of bingo by minors
sponsored.sum: Permits participation in games of bingo by minors who are accompanied by an adult.

sponsored.t: Enacts the residential structure fire prevention act of 2026
sponsored.sum: Enacts the residential structure fire prevention act; provides a tax credit to homeowners who remove cock loft fire hazards in their homes; provides an insurance discount for the installation of smoke detecting alarm devices in cock lofts; provides that the repair of cock lofts for the purpose of fire prevention and safety shall be qualifying expenditures under state housing programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to welfare, medical, and retirement plans provided by a horsemen's organization in the absence of contractual obligations
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to welfare, medical, and retirement plans provided by a horsemen's organization in the absence of contractual obligations; provides that in the absence of a contract between the licensed harness racing corporation or association and the representative horsemen's organization, the previous contract shall be automatically extended for a one-time period of twelve months commencing from the date that the previously negotiated contract expired.

sponsored.t: Relate to a real property tax exemption for veterans with a one hundred percent service connected disability
sponsored.sum: Establishes an additional real property tax exemption for the primary residence of veterans with a one hundred percent service connected disability.

sponsored.t: Relates to the time frames for certain court filings
sponsored.sum: Relates to the time frames for certain court filings and the effectiveness of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to setback requirements relating to the siting of battery energy storage systems
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of public service to promulgate rules, regulations and model policies regarding setback requirements for the siting of battery energy storage systems; requires minimum setback requirements for commercial energy storage systems, with a capacity of three megawatts or greater, of no less than seven hundred fifty feet from residential property and no less than three hundred feet from residential property located in a city with a population of one million or more inhabitants; requires public hearings prior to the approval of an application for a permit for such systems.

sponsored.t: Requires a 120-day warning period for violations at certain veterans' organization facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires a 120-day warning period for violations at congressionally chartered veterans' organization facilities.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain local municipal agencies to use surveillance cameras to combat illegal dumping
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain local municipal agencies to use surveillance cameras to combat illegal dumping.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "licensed funeral arranger act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "licensed funeral arranger act" under which a "licensed funeral arranger" license allows a funeral arranger to perform all acts permitted to a funeral director except embalming or any preservation of the body of a deceased person requiring embalming; creates a registration process under which registered transporters facilitate the removal and transportation of the bodies of deceased persons.
sponsored.fis: There will be some additional costs for the Department of Health.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing that the ballots of deceased military personnel shall be counted toward the election for which they were cast
sponsored.sum: Provides that the ballots of deceased military personnel shall be counted toward the election for which they were cast.

sponsored.t: Makes intentional damage to an authorized emergency vehicle a crime of criminal mischief in the third degree
sponsored.sum: Makes intentional damage to an authorized emergency vehicle a crime of criminal mischief in the third degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic bell jar vending machines
sponsored.sum: Relates to the authorization and regulation of the use of electronic bell jar vending machines; relates to the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Establishes a new assault crime for an assault on a retired police officer who previously arrested the assailant
sponsored.sum: Establishes a new assault crime for an assault on a retired police officer who previously arrested the assailant; establishes that assaulting such a retired police officer with intent to seek retribution is assault in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Grants temporary parking permits for handicapped parking spaces to pregnant persons
sponsored.sum: Grants temporary parking permits for handicapped parking spaces to pregnant persons; requires certification from a physician; provides that such permit terminates at the end of the pregnancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring venues of public accommodation to maintain accessible parking in accordance with federal law
sponsored.sum: Requires venues of public accommodation to maintain accessible parking in accordance with federal law; establishes penalties and enforcement mechanisms for the division of human rights and local governments.
sponsored.fis: None for the State beyond modest administrative costs to the Division of Human Rights to manage certifications and audits, which may be offset by civil penalties.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of leg-gripping traps
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of leg-gripping traps.

sponsored.t: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers
sponsored.sum: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to on duty auxiliary police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to an increase in punishment for certain actions against on-duty auxiliary police officers such as criminally negligent homicide, assault or menacing of such officer.

sponsored.t: Requires public employers who opt out of providing paid family leave benefits to provide parental leave in the alternative
sponsored.sum: Requires public employers who opt out of providing paid family leave benefits to provide parental leave in the alternative at the same pay rate and amount of time as paid family leave.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rejection by voting machines of ballots that contain a vote for a candidate who previously withdrew from an election
sponsored.sum: Relates to the rejection by voting machines of ballots that contain a vote for a candidate who previously withdrew from an election.

sponsored.t: Enacts the automobile insurance consumer information act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "automobile insurance consumer information act"; provides for automobile insurance consumer information and complaint ranking; creates office of public insurance consumer advocate and powers and duties therefor; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Limits co-payments for physical and occupational therapy services
sponsored.sum: Limits co-payments for physical and occupational therapy services.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing transportation for children with a disability
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing transportation for children with a disability; removes the requirement that a child attends the school the district is providing transportation to for the purpose of receiving services or programs similar to special educational programs recommended for such child by the local committee on special education.

sponsored.t: Allows the granting of academic credit at city or state operated institutions to veterans
sponsored.sum: Allows the granting of academic credit at state or city operated institutions to veterans.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the impoundment of vehicles operated by intoxicated or impaired persons
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the impoundment of vehicles operated by intoxicated or impaired persons; authorizes the release of impounded vehicles to owners of such vehicles if certain criteria is met; authorizes a reasonable fee for towing and storage of such vehicles.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Ildefonso Romero's law" to establish the felony offense of aggravated assault
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Ildefonso Romero's law" to establish the felony offense of aggravated assault for the causation of serious physical injury to or death of, as the case may be, any person, with intent to cause physical injury to such person or a third person.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of motorized scooters
sponsored.sum: Provides for the regulation of motorized scooters including registration, safety and equipment, prohibitions on unsafe operation and insurance requirements.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cannabis retail and on-site consumption licensees from operating such premises within one thousand feet of the perimeter of a school grounds
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cannabis retail and on-site consumption licensees from operating such premises within one thousand feet of the perimeter of a school grounds; prohibits the advertising and marketing of cannabis content within one thousand feet of the perimeter of a school grounds, playgrounds, child day care providers, public parks, and libraries.

sponsored.t: Revokes community supervision for certain conduct
sponsored.sum: Revokes community supervision for certain conduct involving kidnapping, coercion, firearms, dangerous weapons, and other conduct.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a distinctive plate for combat veterans having served in the navy, marine corps, air force or coast guard
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a distinctive plate for combat veterans having served in the navy, marine corps, air force or coast guard.

sponsored.t: Requires a public hearing to be held when land is proposed to be converted for public use
sponsored.sum: Requires that when the state or an organization is attempting to convert land to public use in a municipality with a population of less than one million, a hearing shall be held in such municipality where such land is located to allow for public comment and input from neighbors; requires a ten day notice of such hearing to members of the community.

sponsored.t: Provides for a priority call system for use in connection with emergency disconnections of utilities, service coverage and oversight of response time
sponsored.sum: Provides for a priority call system for use in connection with emergency disconnections of utilities, service coverage and oversight of response time in connection with the emergency disconnection of utilities.

sponsored.t: Increases the minimum insurance coverage requirements for motor vehicles rented or leased in the state
sponsored.sum: Increases the minimum insurance coverage requirements for motor vehicles rented or leased in the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a task force to study the frequency and seriousness of violence that occurs on school grounds and the causes of such violence; and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes a rebuttable presumption of a hate crime when certain crimes are committed on, in or upon a house of worship
sponsored.sum: Establishes a rebuttable presumption of a hate crime when certain crimes are committed on, in or upon a house of worship.

sponsored.t: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree and the victim is a police officer
sponsored.sum: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree and the victim is a police officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to purchasing restrictions on persons boycotting Israel and the investment of certain public funds in companies boycotting Israel
sponsored.sum: Relates to purchasing restrictions on persons boycotting Israel and the investment of certain public funds in companies boycotting Israel; requires the commissioner of general services to compile a list of companies boycotting Israel; establishes that such companies will be considered non-responsive bidders.

sponsored.t: Requires high schools to carry and have a trained employee to administer opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires high schools to carry and have a trained employee to administer opioid antagonists during all school hours and after school activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a licensed massage therapist to display such licensed massage therapist's license when practicing and the required contents of such license
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring a licensed massage therapist to display such licensed massage therapist's license when practicing and the required contents of such license, including at a minimum the licensee's name, license number and a non-removable photograph of such licensee.

sponsored.t: Relates to instruction in financial management
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in financial management for all students in grades four through eight.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting "Priscilla's law" requiring ebikes and electric scooters to be registered and have license plates
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in a city with a population of one million or more be registered with the department of motor vehicles and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

sponsored.t: Waives certain licensure fees for veterans
sponsored.sum: Waives certain licensure fees for veterans.

sponsored.t: Waives certain licensure fees for seniors
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensure fees for seniors.

sponsored.t: Relates to the offense of aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Includes use of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument in the offense of aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Establishes a Native nation consultation policy
sponsored.sum: Directs the secretary of state to establish a Native nation consultation policy used by state agencies in instances where a proposal by such agency that would affect indigenous communities is under consideration.

sponsored.t: Provides that impersonation of a disabled veteran vendor is a class A misdemeanor
sponsored.sum: Provides that impersonation of a disabled veteran vendor, by carrying or possessing a specialized vending license without authority or any form of insignia or by words or actions is a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Provides free use of state parks for members or citizens of state or federally recognized Native American nations
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Provides free use of public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state for members or citizens of state or federally recognized Native American nations.

sponsored.t: Requires that the same educational requirements shall apply for students who require nursing services as for general education students
sponsored.sum: Requires that the same educational requirements shall apply for students who require nursing services as for general education students; provides that nursing services may be delivered to students with disabilities through electronic communication or a virtual or online platform or in the home of the student.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the district attorney to intervene in a proceeding brought by the owner of a premises upon which the tenant's occupancy is illegal
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the district attorney to intervene in a proceeding brought by the owner of a premises upon which the tenant's occupancy is illegal.

sponsored.t: Prohibits individuals under the age of twenty-one from gambling
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits individuals under the age of twenty-one from gambling.

sponsored.t: Relates to interactive gaming
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes interactive gaming and interactive lottery gaming in the state of New York.
sponsored.fis: New York State would receive approximately $1 billion annually in State tax revenue based upon conservative market estimates. In addition, in the first year of operation, New York would receive approximately $150 million in one-time license fees from casinos, operators, and independ- ent contractors seeking to conduct online interactive casino gaming.

sponsored.t: Authorizes one percent of mobile sports tax revenue be used for problem gambling
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes one percent of mobile sports tax revenue, but not less than six million dollars, to be used for problem gambling.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have a minimal fiscal impact on the State. It would provide an additional couple million dollars to the OASAS on an annual basis. Based on FY 2024-2025 projections the increase to one percent would be an additional $3 million.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing season-long proposition bets and future award winners as authorized bets
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Allows season-long proposition bets and future award winners as authorized bets; sets limitations for in-game and season-long proposition bets.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have a minimum fiscal impact to the State and local governments. By expanding the MSW product it will potentially bring additional tax revenue.

sponsored.t: Relates to interactive fantasy sports
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Includes contests wherein participants select whether athletes, in the case of sporting events, shall accumulate more or less than a target score set by an operator, as an interactive fantasy sports contest; provides a definition for interactive fantasy sports gross revenue; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: Increased revenue to the state through licensing fees and tax revenue.

sponsored.t: Includes the use of a governmental agency to harass a person within the crime of harassment in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Includes the use of a governmental agency to harass a person within the crime of aggravated harassment in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Allows for child beneficiaries of deceased police officers and firefighters to receive accidental death benefits until age twenty-six
sponsored.sum: Allows for child beneficiaries of deceased police officers and firefighters to receive accidental death benefits until age twenty-six.

sponsored.t: Provides for licensure of a massage therapy establishment
sponsored.sum: Establishes the process for a massage therapy establishment to be duly licensed; provides for the application process; sets standards for massage therapy establishments; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides school preference when a student is applying to the same public elementary or middle school as a sibling
sponsored.sum: Provides that in a city with a population of one million or more, where a student is applying to attend a public elementary or middle school and such student has a sibling who already attends such school, such student whose application is pending shall be given preference for admission.

sponsored.t: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to participate in district interscholastic sports
sponsored.sum: Allows school districts to permit home-schooled students to participate in district interscholastic sports.

sponsored.t: Clarifies certain provisions regarding conflicts of interest of certain public employees
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Clarifies certain provisions regarding conflicts of interest of certain public employees regarding the licensing of a participant in horse racing activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the acceleration of the downstate casino licenses
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the acceleration of the downstate casino licenses; sets forth fixed deadlines for different steps of the application process.
sponsored.fis: A minimum of $1.5 billion dollars in licensing fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to retail premises of lithium-ion batteries, bicycles with electric assist, micromobility devices, and limited use motorcycles
sponsored.sum: Requires any dealer where lithium-ion batteries, bicycles with electric assist, micromobility devices and limited use motorcycles are sold at retail or repaired, and/or lithium-ion electric batteries are housed in a storage facility to maintain functional fire protection and suppression measures effective against lithium-ion battery and electrical fires, including but not limited to Class B extinguishers, battery cases, and automatic monitoring and detection; authorizes the department of state to promulgate necessary rules and regulations; imposes a fine of $250 for a knowing violation to comply with such provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires certain railroad corporations to submit quarterly inspection reports to the department of transportation
sponsored.sum: Requires every railroad corporation which operates any freight train within the state to submit quarterly reports to the department of transportation detailing such railroad corporation's inspections of any train yard and freight train operated in the state by such corporation; directs the department of transportation to conduct follow up inspections.

sponsored.t: Establishes a course of study in financial education for certain students
sponsored.sum: Establishes a half-credit course in financial education delivered by means of a comprehensive financial literacy program for all pupils in grades nine, ten, eleven or twelve.

sponsored.t: Authorizes occupational therapy services to be provided in school to certain students
sponsored.sum: Authorizes occupational therapy services to be provided in school to students in grades pre-kindergarten through twelve with occupational impairments of a severity that does not adversely affect the student's educational performance but does present a barrier to functioning at home or in the community; directs the commissioner to promulgate rules and regulations for the provision of such occupational therapy services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of flavored smokeless tobacco within five hundred feet of a public or private elementary or secondary school
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of flavored smokeless tobacco within five hundred feet of a public or private elementary or secondary school; defines "flavored smokeless tobacco"; authorizes the commissioner to impose a civil penalty for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of retirement service identification cards to auxiliary police officers
sponsored.sum: Directs local law enforcement agencies in municipalities authorizing an auxiliary police force by local law to provide retirement service identification cards to auxiliary police officers who retire with 10 or more years of service or who are injured in the course of duty and unable to continue duty due to such injury.

sponsored.t: Requires each public body to live stream and post video recordings of all open meetings and public hearings
sponsored.sum: Requires each public body to live stream and post video recordings of all open meetings and public hearings; requires each public body to post such recordings for a period of not less than five years.

sponsored.t: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls during certain declared states of emergency
sponsored.sum: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls during a declared state of emergency or disaster emergency where the declaration or proclamation of emergency includes a finding that unsolicited telemarketing sales calls would impair actions taken to limit, control, or mitigate the emergency; explains the basis of such finding; provides that such prohibition may not extend for a period of more than two weeks, subject to renewal for additional two-week periods by further findings of necessity made at the end of each two-week period.

sponsored.t: Relates to operating historical horse racing products
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the operation of historical horse racing; provides for the payment distribution of all pari-mutuel handle derived from historical horse racing.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have a positive increase in revenue for pari-mutuel wagering.

sponsored.t: Provides a non-revenue E-ZPass to every sworn officer of the metropolitan transportation police department
sponsored.sum: Provides a non-revenue E-ZPass to every sworn officer of the metropolitan transportation police department; provides for the disposal of such E-ZPass after a police officer leaves the metropolitan transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to self-exclusion provisions
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to self-exclusion provisions; provides for moneys forfeited by self-exclusion to be deposited in certain gaming commission accounts.

sponsored.t: Establishes staffing standards for physical therapists and therapist assistants, occupational therapists and therapy assistants, respiratory therapists and therapy technicians and recreational therapists
sponsored.sum: Includes physical therapists, physical therapist assistants, occupational therapists, occupational therapy assistants, respiratory therapists, respiratory therapy technicians, and recreational therapists within the existing statutory staffing standards for nursing homes.

sponsored.t: Requires rip current, rip tide and undertow curriculum or instruction
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Alexandra's law" to require school districts and charter schools to include in the curriculum or instruction teaching students how to recognize and react to rip currents, rip tides and undertows.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the fair market value of labor rates for services covered under motor vehicle insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of financial services, in consultation with the department of transportation to conduct a study and prepare a report on the fair market value of labor rates for services covered under motor vehicle insurance policies.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state thoroughbred breeding and development fund
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Increases the excess limit for funds in the New York state thoroughbred breeding and development fund from seventy-five thousand dollars to five hundred thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage of outpatient problem gambling services
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies to cover outpatient problem gambling services.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for veterans with a 100 percent service connected disability
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for the primary residence of veterans with a 100 percent service connected disability.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 53 Chapter 672 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 1183, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the real property tax law, in relation to estab- lishing a real property tax exemption for veterans who have a one hundred percent service connected disability" APPROVED This bill would expand the Alternative Veterans Exemption Real Proper- ty Tax Law (RPTL) Section 458-a by authorizing counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts to provide, at local option, a real prop- erty tax exemption to veterans with a 100% service-connected disability. Service-connected disabilities can render veteran's incapable of gain- ful employment and providing for their families. This bill created a local option tax exemption for seriously disabled veterans that dupli- cated an existing mandatory provision. This redundancy could cause confusion about what additional benefit the new…

sponsored.t: Relates to welfare, medical, and retirement plans provided by a horsemen's organization in the absence of contractual obligations
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to welfare, medical, and retirement plans provided by a horsemen's organization in the absence of contractual obligations; provides in the absence of a contract between the licensed harness racing corporation or association and the representative horsemen's organization, the state gaming commission shall require such corporation or association to pay to the horsemen's organization an amount determined in accordance with the previously negotiated contract for welfare, medical, or retirement plans, including any associated costs, provided by the horsemen's organization to participants in racing at the licensed harness racing facility; provides the amounts shall be paid monthly from…

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 60 Chapter 680 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 2612-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation to welfare, medical, and retirement plans provided by a horsemen's organization in the absence of contractual obli- gations" APPROVED This bill directs the gaming commission to require a harness racing corporation or association to pay the horsemen's organization an amount determined in accordance with the previously negotiated contract for welfare, medical, or retirement plans. Generally, collective bargaining agreements should be negotiated between the parties and not through legislation. While I am not opposed to extending the timeframe during which the parties can negotiate, this bill would have extended that timeframe indefinitely. I have reached an agreement with the legislature to address this issue and…

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic bell jar vending machines
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing and regulating the use of electronic bell jar vending machines; requires responsible placement and operation of electronic bell jar vending machines; allows for geographic considerations for such machine placement.
sponsored.fis: Potential for enhanced revenues to the state through licensing fees and from charitable gaming.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 74 Chapter 697 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 6351-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, in relation to electron- ic bell jar games" APPROVED This bill would allow any authorized organization to utilize electron- ic bell jar machines. Bell jar games are a means of fundraising for numerous charitable organizations. Electronic bell jar machines offer a new, updated method of play for this charitable fundraising game. As written, the expansive scope of this bill would have led to the potential proliferation of bell jar machines throughout the state, including in close proximity to tribal and commercial casinos. I have reached an agreement with the legislature to ensure that our state does not become over saturated, by permitting them to be cited by volunteer firefighters and veterans' organizations that are existing licensees. Based…

sponsored.t: Enacts the avoiding vexatious overuse of impleading to delay (AVOID) act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "avoiding vexatious overuse of impleading to delay (AVOID) act" which relates to time frames for certain court filings.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 80 Chapter 704 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 8071-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the civil practice law and rules, in relation to enacting the "avoiding vexatious overuse of impleading to delay (AVOID) act"" APPROVED This bill makes important changes to civil procedure to allow parties to more efficiently litigate claims involving third party defendants by requiring such defendants to be served within twenty days of filing the third party summons and complaint instead of 120 days and requiring that a third party summons and complaint be filed before certain deadlines. I support efforts to make our legal system more efficient and provide timely justice to parties. The bill as drafted, however, contained ambi- guities as to when the time for filing a summons and complaint would begin to run, treated third party defendants differently depending on when…

sponsored.t: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide forty-five days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
sponsored.sum: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide forty-five days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 80 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 1194-B, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public service law, in relation to requiring gas and electric corporations to provide forty-five days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase" NOT APPROVED This bill would direct the Public Service Commission to require all gas and electric utilities to provide at least forty-five days' written notice to each customer when there is a service rate or charge increase. While I agree with the need to provide further transparency for rate- payers, this bill would likely result in inaccurate estimated rates and frustrate the intent of the law. Additionally, any increased costs to implement this bill, including updating billing systems, would ultimate- ly be passed on to ratepayers, which is…

sponsored.t: Prohibits online sweepstakes games and revenue from illegal markets
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits online sweepstakes games and revenue from illegal markets; sets penalties; provides for enforcement of provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to funds in the Catskill off-track betting corporation's capital acquisition fund
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that from April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026, twenty-three percent of funds in the Catskill off-track betting corporation's capital acquisition fund shall be made available for certain past due obligations; requires such corporation to submit an expenditure plan for approval before accessing such funds.
sponsored.fis: This bill has no direct negative fiscal impact on the State, as it authorizes the use of the corporation's own existing funds. It may have a positive fiscal impact by enabling the payment of past-due obligations to the State and State-supported breeding funds.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 101 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 8419, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation to funds in the Catskill off-track betting corpo- ration's capital acquisition fund" NOT APPROVED This bill would allow the Catskill off-track betting (OTB) corporation to invade its capital acquisition fund to pay down certain debt. For the past three years, the state has authorized OTB corporations to access their capital acquisition funds ("CAF") to pay down existing debts. However, before an OTB was allowed to access this money pursuant to this law, it had to attest that it was compliant with current law and was not using money that belonged to other entities. Catskill was unable to make such an attestation in each of those years and was therefore not allowed to…

sponsored.t: Requires harness racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires harness racetrack locations awarded a gaming facility license maintain live racing activity.

sponsored.t: Creates the jockey health insurance reserve fund
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Creates the jockey health insurance reserve fund for the payment of premiums not yet paid; provides for the return of funds if such reserve fund becomes no longer necessary.

sponsored.t: Relates to the thoroughbred breeding and development fund
sponsored.sum: Extends the provisions relating to the New York state thoroughbred breeding and development fund until seventeen years after the commencement of the operation of a video lottery terminal facility at Aqueduct racetrack.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impact to the State or to local govern- ments.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory health insurance coverage for follow-up screening or diagnostic services for lung cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires that health insurance policies shall provide coverage for follow-up screening or diagnostic services for lung cancer; provides that no patient cost sharing shall be imposed for follow-up screening or diagnostic services for lung cancer.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for prenatal vitamins
sponsored.sum: Relates to coverage for prenatal vitamins and related insurance coverages.
